metadata.description: mop: slop mops for Claude Code, plus the slopmop ESLint config they use.

plugins.name: mop
plugins.description: Slop mops: /mop cleans everything a branch changed; /mop:tests, /mop:code, /mop:docs and /mop:ui each run one detect, fix and verify loop with proof nothing broke; /mop:break tries to break the result.
